facts.business: Kirloskar Electric Company Limited manufactures a diversified range of electrical equipment and engineered solutions including rotating machines, transformers, switchgear, AC/DC motors, EV motors, traction equipment, AC generators, DG sets, and customised engineering solutions for industrial and infrastructure sectors.

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: No modification in respect of unaudited subsidiary (total assets ₹1.25 lakhs), associate Kirloskar (Malaysia) Sdn Bhd, and Ajman Branch office audited by branch auditor

facts.related_party_note: All related party transactions during FY 2025-26 were on arm's length basis and in ordinary course of business, approved by Audit Committee. No material transactions requiring AOC-2 disclosure. Non-executive directors had no pecuniary relationship except sitting fees and reimbursement. Key transactions include purchases from Vijay Farms (₹49.04 lakhs), Sri Vijayadurga Investments (₹221.31 lakhs), sales to Kirloskar Malaysia (₹25.09 lakhs) and Kirsons Trading (₹108.83 lakhs), and remuneration to KMPs.
